messages:
maria: Hey team quick Q — my partner's daughter (turning 25) arrived on F-1 in June and started classes 06/08. Can I add her mid-year? Open enrollment closed.

people-ops: Hi @maria — short: stepchild eligible if under 26. Becoming a full-time student or recently moving to the US can qualify as a QLE. We need the dates and supporting docs to evaluate.

maria: I don't have formal custody papers, just a notarized affidavit from my partner confirming custody for the school year. No SSN yet. Is that acceptable?

alex: Notarized affidavit is acceptable for intake but carriers sometimes request additional evidence of relationship (e.g., child's birth certificate showing parent, or a parent ID). Required docs we accept: passport + I-20, current university enrollment letter with start date and full-time status, proof of relationship (birth cert or parent ID) and the notarized affidavit if custody docs are informal. If SSN is missing we'll set SSN=TBD and you can update later.

benefits-bot: Secure upload: https://benefits.redwood.com/upload — choose category: dependent_enrollment. Filename convention: lastname_firstname_doc_YYYYMMDD.pdf (example: gonzalez_ana_i20_20260608.pdf). Allowed: pdf, jpg, png.

people-ops: Timing notes: 1) Upload the docs and include the move/enrollment date in the notes. 2) If carrier accepts this as a QLE, coverage can be effective back to the event date; otherwise it will wait until next open enrollment. 3) Payroll will pick up deductions the first full pay cycle after the carrier confirms enrollment (typically 1–2 pay periods). We'll tag payroll when we have carrier confirmation.

maria: Uploaded: gonzalez_ana_i20_20260608.pdf — I included I-20, enrollment letter (start date 2026-06-08), passport scan, and notarized affidavit from my partner. Thanks for the help! :pray:

benefits-bot: Upload received: gonzalez_ana_i20_20260608.pdf. Intake ticket #B-2026-910 created. Estimated review 1-3 business days. We'll update this thread when the carrier responds. :white_check_mark:
